description: This Java class `ApiExceptionHandler` handles exceptions thrown within a Spring Boot web application, mapping various internal exceptions to appropriate HTTP responses for API clients.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller advice that maps internal exceptions to HTTP responses for API clients.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles ValidationException by returning HTTP 400 Bad Request with an error response.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFoundException by returning HTTP 404 Not Found with an error response.

methods.name: handleConfig
methods.description: Handles ConfigurationException by returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable with an error response.

methods.name: handleProvider
methods.description: Handles ProviderException by logging a warning and returning HTTP 502 Bad Gateway with an error response.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles generic Exception by logging an error and returning HTTP 500 Internal Server Error with a generic message.
